claims.claim: Structured discretization error produces measurable neighbor and signed-max winner disagreement in dynamic vision graphs.
claims.mechanism: Signed multi-threshold coding perturbs features; kNN and signed max convert small perturbations into discrete flips.
claims.assumptions: A public or locally reproducible dynamic-graph teacher and public calibration data exist.
claims.falsifying_ablation: Replace quantized features with teacher features and verify disagreement vanishes.
claims.split_protocol: Official CIFAR-10 train/test; fixed calibration subset from train; three training splits; test frozen before tuning.
claims.primary_metric: layerwise neighbor Jaccard and max-winner agreement
claims.minimum: Measurable disagreement and a valid oracle intervention.
claims.expected_strong: At T<=4, baseline loses at least 5 pp neighbor Jaccard or 2 pp winner agreement and restoring teacher structure recovers at least half the accuracy loss.
claims.failure: Less than 1 percent structure disagreement and less than 1 pp accuracy gap at T=4.
claims.strong_baseline: independently reimplemented signed multi-threshold coding from the published DCGS algorithm
claims.matched_control: signed uniform quantization at the same nominal levels and event budget
claims.implementation_path: Reproduce a small ViG-style Grapher operator in PyTorch from the paper; implement signed multi-threshold coding separately from upstream code.
claims.prototype_check: 64 samples through one Grapher block with shape and finite-value assertions.
claims.calibration_evidence: Imported audit plus direct arXiv and GitHub checks recorded in prior-art-opportunity-map.md.
claims.test_isolation: Official test used once after configuration freeze.
claims.stop_return_condition: Failed license, data, baseline, prototype, or budget condition returns to scenario design before a full campaign.

claims.claim: Structure-aware calibration improves discrete agreement at a matched event budget.
claims.mechanism: Calibration minimizes topology and winner disagreement instead of activation MSE alone.
claims.assumptions: C1 is observed and the calibration signal transfers to held-out examples.
claims.falsifying_ablation: Activation-MSE calibration with equal parameters and event budget matches or beats structure-aware calibration.
claims.split_protocol: Same frozen CIFAR-10 protocol as C1.
claims.primary_metric: structure disagreement recovery at matched event count
claims.minimum: No degradation beyond seed noise versus matched baseline.
claims.expected_strong: At least 50 percent recovery of baseline disagreement loss with no higher event count and at most 1 pp teacher accuracy gap.
claims.failure: No recovery over activation-MSE control or recovery only with a deployable teacher-structure oracle.
claims.strong_baseline: signed multi-threshold coding with matched calibration budget
claims.matched_control: same parameter count and event budget
claims.implementation_path: Add a calibration objective over training-subset Grapher outputs and freeze parameters before test.
claims.prototype_check: Calibration loss decreases on train/calibration data without test labels.
claims.calibration_evidence: Baseline gap measured in run R2 before tuning.
claims.stop_return_condition: If C1 fails, C2 is void and the run returns to scenario selection.

claims.claim: Discrete structure preservation causally explains accuracy recovery.
claims.mechanism: Teacher-neighbor and teacher-winner oracles isolate the contribution of each discrete decision.
claims.assumptions: Oracle interventions are valid diagnostics and not deployable components.
claims.falsifying_ablation: Both-oracle intervention does not improve accuracy while the method does.
claims.split_protocol: Same frozen CIFAR-10 protocol as C1.
claims.primary_metric: accuracy recovery attributable to structure restoration
claims.expected_strong: Method recovers at least half of both-oracle accuracy recovery.
claims.failure: Oracle interventions do not change accuracy or method gains are orthogonal to structure agreement.
claims.implementation_path: Modify Grapher to accept teacher indices/winners during diagnostic only.
claims.prototype_check: Oracle exactly matches teacher layer outputs when quantized activations are also replaced.
claims.calibration_evidence: Intervention gains measured on the frozen test after design freeze.
claims.test_isolation: Any test-driven redesign marks the test exposed and opens a replacement contract.
claims.stop_return_condition: Test exposure or invalid oracle semantics returns to the earliest affected stage.
